QUESTION: During the week of 2026-07-27 to 2026-07-31, a series of fixes were built for the Mott SMS booking system (Bland pathway + AWS gateway). A pathway rebuild on Jul 31 then silently erased the pathway-side halves of some of these fixes. Catalog WHAT each fix was, WHERE it lives (gateway-side code vs pathway-side node config vs both), and exactly which pathway node fields each fix requires (body fields like callID/after/time_pref, extractVars, prompts).

SOURCES (read these directories; each contains manifest JSONs whose task 'spec' fields describe what was built, plus work dirs with the artifacts): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-raw-text/ (raw-text date authority), /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-llm-intent/ (LLM intent tier), /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-weekday-conflict/, /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-date-arch/, /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-gw-temporal/, /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-help-node/, /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-intent-arch/, /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-extraction-probe/. Also /home/ankit114/repos/mott-v21-snap/docs/ for design notes.

OUTPUT ./report.md with: (1) a 'Fix inventory' table: fix name, date, what it does, gateway-side artifact, pathway-side requirement (exact fields/nodes), evidence file; (2) a 'Pathway-side requirements' section listing EVERY node field the full fix set needs present in a healthy pathway version (this is the checklist a rebuild must satisfy); (3) a 'WIRING' section describing how callID flows from conversation to gateway and what the gateway does with it; (4) a fenced block starting with ```json CITATIONS containing a JSON list of at least 10 {"file": "<absolute path>", "quote": "<short verbatim substring from that file>"} pairs backing your key claims. Quotes must be copied EXACTLY from the files. Final message: 5-line summary.
tasks.verified: A cited catalog of every fix-week change and the exact pathway-side fields a rebuild must preserve, with 10+ verbatim citations verified against the source files.

You are a read-only research scout. Do not modify anything outside your working directory; no network, no git, no MCP, no skills. Write exactly one file: ./report.md.

TASK: Map the complete availability/scheduling wiring of the KNOWN-GOOD Bland pathway graph at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/pathway-v86.json (42 nodes, 114 edges). This map is the blueprint for restoring that wiring into a newer graph, so precision matters more than prose.

Cover: (1) the four availability webhook nodes (n_search, n_page_2, n_page_3, n_page_near): full body JSON, full responseData (name<-jsonpath pairs), full responsePathways (condition -> destination), and how they differ from each other; (2) WHERE {{time_after}} and {{callID}} come from — find every node whose extractVars or system context produces these variables, quote the extraction definitions; (3) the offer nodes their routes lead to (n_offer, n_offer_2, n_offer_3 and any sibling): quote the sentences in each prompt that make claims about lateness/afternoon/closeness, and state whether the query semantics make each claim true; (4) n_date_conflict and n_help: their type, purpose (from their prompt/text), inbound and outbound edges (source -> target with labels); (5) an 'EDGE LIST' section: every edge touching any node named above, as source -> target [label].

METHOD: write and run a small Python script over the JSON; do not eyeball. OUTPUT ./report.md with sections 'Availability nodes', 'Variable provenance', 'Offer prompts', 'Dropped nodes', 'EDGE LIST', 'WIRING' (one-paragraph synthesis), and a fenced ```json CITATIONS block with at least 8 {"file", "quote"} pairs where file is the pathway-v86.json path and each quote is a short verbatim substring of that file (e.g. a body string or condition literal). Final message: 5-line summary.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/checks/check_research_citations.py --file report.md --min-citations 8 --require 'Availability nodes' --require 'Variable provenance' --require 'EDGE LIST' --require 'time_after' --require 'WIRING'
tasks.verified: A machine-verified wiring blueprint of v86's availability cluster: bodies, extractions, routes, prompts, and every touching edge, each claim backed by verbatim quotes from the graph JSON.
